label: Proof Frame
description: The proof placed BESIDE the person instead of over them (SPEC-creator-formats.md): on a TV, a laptop, a phone, a whiteboard, a plated card, or bare on top for a reaction. Self-placing over the whole stage: the frame goes on the side away from the face (or data.side), sized for the canvas, landing on its word. The build casts it from a proof need's use (tv | laptop | phone | whiteboard | card | point | react); a slate stands in it until the file lands.

src.label: Image or clip URL (omit: the slate)

chrome.label: tv | laptop | phone | whiteboard | card (default) | none

place.label: side (default: beside the person) | split (on top on a tall frame, a big side box on a wide one -- a reaction's source)

side.label: left | right (default: away from the face)

title.label: Whiteboard only: a marker title over the pinned proof

at.label: Seconds (or a word anchor) it lands

exit_at.label: Seconds (or a word anchor) it leaves

need.label: Slate: the need it waits for

asset_type.label: Slate: the kind of file needed
